label: GO step after a reward obtained in S1 (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 in 100% of activations). Essentially never fires after a reward in S2: prev_state != 2 keeps 99.4% of activations (prev_state is -1 only on the first trial of a window, where the earlier state is out of view; with prev_state==1 strictly, recall is 0.79, F1 0.44). It also dies out late in the episode (rate falls after trial ~50, nothing after trial ~85), so ep_trial < 80 is included. The predicate is close to a necessary condition (dev mass recall ~1.0) but not sufficient: precision is only ~0.25, since many GO steps after an S1 reward stay silent. Magnitude builds up over runs of consecutive rewarded S1 trials (in top windows activation rises across successive rewarded a1->S1 trials up to max) and goes with high value (7.5-8.1) and a positive a1 policy logit; 77% of the mass is on trials where the agent chooses a1, but it also fires weakly when a2 is chosen after a rare a2->S1 reward. Requiring that the reward two trials back was not 0 improves F1 to ~0.47-0.54. Uses only observed history, with no future variables. Roughly: a reward-in-S1 / S1-is-good evidence accumulator, read out at GO.
